identity.mfa_scope: all privileged accounts and remote network access
identity.password_policy: 14 character minimum with complexity rules enforced
identity.password_storage: passwords stored as salted bcrypt hashes

access_control.least_privilege_model: role-based access with quarterly entitlement reviews
access_control.remote_access: VPN with monitored and logged sessions

logging.siem: centralized audit log retention for 12 months
logging.user_attribution: unique user IDs required, shared accounts disabled

network.dmz: public web servers logically separated in DMZ subnet
network.encryption_in_transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced for all CUI transmission
network.encryption_at_rest: BitLocker full disk encryption on all endpoints

incident_response.plan: documented IR plan with containment and recovery phases
incident_response.reporting: incidents reported to designated officials within 72 hours
